title: A finite-termination algorithm for testing copositivity over the positive semidefinite cone
summary: This paper proposes an efficient algorithm for testing copositivity of homogeneous polynomials over the positive semidefinite cone. The algorithm is based on a novel matrix optimization reformulation and requires solving a hierarchy of semidefinite programs. Notably, it always terminates in finitely many iterations. If a homogeneous polynomial is copositive over the positive semidefinite cone, the algorithm provides a certificate; otherwise, it returns a vector that refutes copositivity.
